| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Output** `output` | Regions | Regions, Elevation (gradient), Boundaries over the image, Mean color of each region | The regions as a label map, drawn over the image and listed in the Features panel. Or the elevation that is flooded, the Sobel gradient, stretched. Or the boundaries in yellow over the image, or each region filled with its mean color. |
| **Smoothing** `sigma` | 1 | 0 to 5 px | The sigma of a Gaussian blur of the luma before the Sobel gradient. 0 turns the blur off. |
| **Depth h** `h` | 10 | 0.5 to 200 | A valley of the gradient starts a region only when it is at least this deep, in the units of the gradient. A ramp of 1 level per pixel has a gradient of about 1.4. |
| **Compactness** `compactness` | 0 | 0 to 10 | Above 0, the compact watershed of Neubert and Protzel, which also weighs the distance from each marker. scikit-image uses 0, the classic watershed. |
